description: An unfinished Vue 3 front end for editing nested JSON as recursive tables, expecting a separately hosted paginated REST API.
scope_audience: A personal front-end experiment for browsing and mutating nested entities; its README says the backend is not included and the application was never shipped.

creativity.reason: Recursive tables are a familiar editor pattern with a limited adaptation; no distinctive user workflow is established.

current_usefulness.reason: The component edits recursive data locally, but entity loading/saving depends on a missing hard-coded backend, so the documented workflow is incomplete.

expected_usefulness.reason: If paired with a compatible API, a recursive nested-JSON editor could help a narrow data-browsing user; backend behavior and demand are not evidenced.

impl_progress.reason: Recursive array/object/scalar editing exists in Vue components, but backend integration is absent and no tests or complete app acceptance are reported.

presentability.reason: README explains the concept and missing backend but the run command leads to an empty/broken UI without a separate service.

verification: README, recursive component and API-calling front-end source inspected; no backend, build, or UI execution; no payload data inspected.
contribution: A real recursive JSON editor component is present, but the declared paginated API contract and working user path are outside this repository.
alternatives_question: Which current nested-JSON editors support the same recursive table editing against a paginated REST backend, and what caller benefit is distinct?

delivery_likelihood.reason: The project is explicitly deprecated and its required backend is absent from the repository.

reason: The implementation supports a modest substantial-work route, but the missing service blocks current utility and no differentiated outcome is established.
next_step: If reused, document or supply the API contract and prove one complete read-edit-save round trip on non-sensitive fixture data.
